errors.quote: $P_V-P_U$ is the identity on $V\cap U^\perp$ and zero elsewhere
errors.problem: A linear map cannot be zero 'elsewhere'. The paper has 'zero on its orthogonal complement', i.e. on $(V\cap U^\perp)^\perp$. Also, 'the projection $P_U$ onto its label' must be the projection along $U^\perp$ for the form $\langle x,y\rangle=x^{\mathsf T}(I-J/9)y$, which the page does not say.

errors.quote: Gate labels at times $0,\dots,7$ (tensored with $R$) for neighbors $S,T$ at $X,Y$: $$B\otimes\langle t\rangle,\ B\otimes F,\ \dots$$
errors.problem: The time-0 label uses an undefined $t$. In the page's own naming it is $t_T$ (the $Y$-side triple); the paper's side residual source$\to0$ is $B\otimes\langle t_Y\rangle$.

errors.quote: Undoing the bank exchange gives all roles $C^{\otimes m}$.
errors.problem: The scalar network sends $(X_a,Y_a)\mapsto(-Y_a,X_a)$, so the $Y_a\to X_a$ route arrives as $-C^{\otimes m}$. The paper first negates the physical $X$ outputs ('Negate those outputs and send output role $\rho(w)$ back to role $w$'); undoing the exchange alone does not give $C^{\otimes m}$ on every role.
$Z$ must act only on the 27 coordinates of $\operatorname{supp}u_a$, with the identity elsewhere ($Z_{a,k}$ in the paper). On $k$ columns the scalar is $i^{27k}$. As written, '$Z$' is unspecified.
